identity.retryPolicy: Transport failures (timeout (180s), network error, HTTP 408/409/429/5xx, unreadable API response with 5xx, incomplete or missing output) are retried up to 4 attempts per turn with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After and provider reset headers. Live calls use a 5-second minimum pace, increasing automatically to stay under 80% of a reported token/minute limit, and live episodes cool down by 30 seconds; every attempt and sanitized rate-limit header is recorded. Exhausted HTTP 429 retries interrupt the batch as infrastructure rather than counting as model failure. Invalid model output (unparseable JSON, schema violation, refusal) is not retried or repaired: it is recorded as an invalid response and terminates the episode as unsolved. A valid direction that is visibly blocked is not retried or repaired: it is executed as a blocked move, counts as a wall hit, consumes the turn, and the episode continues.

aiTransport.policy: Provider requests use the shared Vercel AI SDK transport with structured output. SDK retries are disabled; Echo Maze owns every retry, pacing delay, and attempt record.

identity.coordinateSystem: Walker-relative coordinates start at (0,0). A successful move right changes x by +1, left by -1, up by +1, down by -1. A blocked move changes nothing. The Walker never receives absolute maze rows/columns.
identity.hiddenStatePolicy: The prompt receives only the narrow observation DTO (open/blocked directions, corridor sightlines, per-visible-cell open directions and isExit flag, last action/result) plus the current run's conversation. No full maze, no exit coordinates, no seed, no optimal route, no unseen cells, and no spectator state may enter the prompt.

At (3,-1). Intersection with left branch (length 2 to (1,-1) turning down) and down branch (length 2 to (3,-3) turning left). Let's explore left branch first. Moving left.
At (2,-1). In corridor between (3,-1) and (1,-1). Moving left to (1,-1) which turns down.
At (1,-1). Open directions: right, down. Down corridor has distance 4 to (1,-5), which turns left. Right goes back to (3,-1). Moving down.
At (1,-2). Vertical corridor going down towards (1,-5) which turns left. Continuing down.
At (1,-3). In vertical corridor. 2 more steps down to (1,-5) corner which turns left. Continuing down.
At (1,-4). 1 step down to (1,-5) which opens left. Moving down.
At corner (1,-5). Open directions: up (back) and left (to (0,-5)). Looking left: distance 1 has cell with open directions [up, right]. Moving left to (0,-5).
At (0,-5). Open: up, right. Up sightline: 2 cells, cell at dist 1 has [up, down], dist 2 has [down, left]. Right is back. Moving up towards (0,-3).
At (0,-4). Corridor continues up 1 step to (0,-3) which turns left. Moving up.
At (0,-3). Open directions are down and left. Looking left: distance 2 cells, ending at (-2,-3) which opens [up, right]. Moving left.
At (-1,-3). Corridor continues left to (-2,-3) which opens up and right. Moving left to (-2,-3).
At (-2,-3). Open: up, right. Up sightline: 2 cells, dist 1 [up,down], dist 2 (-2,-1) [down,left]. Moving up to explore.
At (-2,-2). Corridor continues up 1 step to (-2,-1) which turns left. Moving up.
At (-2,-1). Open directions: down and left. Looking left: distance 1 has (-3,-1) with openDirections [up, right]. Moving left to (-3,-1).
At (-3,-1). Open: up, right. Right is back to (-2,-1). Up has 1 cell at (-3,0) which opens [down, left]. Let's go up.
At (-3,0). Open: down, left. Looking left: dist 1 is (-4,0) [right,left], dist 2 is (-5,0) [right] (dead end!). Down goes back to (-3,-1). Moving left to verify dead end.
At (-4,0). Left is (-5,0) dead end with only right open. We need to backtrack. Moving right back towards (-3,0).
Back at (-3,0). Left branch was a dead end at (-5,0). Backtracking down to (-3,-1).
Back at (-3,-1). Up goes to dead end. Right goes back towards (-2,-1). Moving right to continue backtracking toward the main intersection at (3,-1) or (0,0).
Back at (-2,-1). Open: down, left. Left is where we came from (dead end). Moving down towards (-2,-3).
At (-2,-2). Backtracking down corridor towards (-2,-3). Moving down.
At (-2,-3). Backtracking towards (3,-1) intersection where we can check the down branch at (3,-1) or (0,0) down branch. Moving right to (-1,-3).
At (-1,-3). Continuing right to (0,-3) then down to (0,-5) and back to the unexplored branch at (3,-1). Moving right.
At (0,-3). Open: down, left. Left is back to (-2,-3). Backtracking down towards (0,-5) and (1,-5). Moving down.
At (0,-4). Continuing down to (0,-5) which turns right to (1,-5). Moving down.
At (0,-5). Open: up, right. Up is where we just came from (dead end path). Moving right to (1,-5) to backtrack towards (3,-1).
At (1,-5). Open: up, left. Up leads 4 steps to (1,-1) which turns right to (3,-1). That was our previous junction with an unexplored down branch at (3,-1). Moving up.
At (1,-4). Moving up corridor towards (1,-1). 3 steps remaining to (1,-1).
At (1,-3). Continuing up along corridor towards (1,-1). 2 steps to (1,-1) which turns right to (3,-1). Moving up.
At (1,-2). Corridor continues up 1 step to (1,-1) which turns right towards (3,-1). Moving up.
At (1,-1). Open: right, down. Down goes to the dead end we just explored. Right goes back to junction (3,-1), where the down path is still unexplored. Moving right.
At (2,-1). Corridor between (1,-1) and (3,-1). (3,-1) has up (to (3,0)), down (unexplored!), left (where we came from). Moving right to (3,-1).
At (3,-1) junction. Up goes to start area (3,0). Left leads to the dead-end western loop. Down is unexplored, extending 2 cells to (3,-3) which turns left. Moving down.
At (3,-2). Open: up, down. 1 step down to (3,-3) which turns left with open directions [up, left]. Moving down.

At (0,-7). Open: up, right. Up goes back to (0,-6). Right sightline has distance 2: cell at (1,-7) [right,left], cell at (2,-7) [down,left]. Moving right.

At (2,-7). Open directions: down, left. Left goes back to (1,-7). Down sightline shows (2,-8) with [up,right,left]. Moving down.
At (2,-8). Open: up, right, left. Up goes back to (2,-7) [down,left]. Right is (3,-8) [up,left]. Left goes 3 steps to (-1,-8) [up,right]. Let's explore right first to check if dead end.
